# University of Alberta

> Canada's top-tier research university in Edmonton offering undergraduate, graduate, and continuing education programs across 18 faculties with strong emphasis on experiential learning and professional development.

The University of Alberta is a leading Canadian research institution with 40,000 students, featuring specialized programs in health sciences, graduate studies, and online education. The university emphasizes inclusive education, work-integrated learning, and professional credentials across multiple delivery formats.

## Key Topics

- Undergraduate Admissions
- Graduate Programs
- International Students
- Scholarships & Financial Aid
- Continuing Education
- Online Learning

## Admissions & Programs

- [University of Alberta](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/index.html): University of Alberta homepage: Top 5 Canadian university in Edmonton with 40,000 students.
- [Admissions + Programs](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/admissions-programs/index.html): Central hub for undergraduate, graduate, and continuing education programs.
- [Undergraduate Admissions + Programs](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/admissions/index.html): Undergraduate admissions portal with program search and campus tour information.
- [How to Apply](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/admissions/how-to-apply/index.html): Application steps, requirements, deadlines, and timeline for undergraduates.
- [International Undergraduate Admissions](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/admissions/international-undergraduate-admission.html): International undergraduate admissions and requirements for University of Alberta.

## Tuition, Scholarships & Financial Support

- [Tuition, Scholarships + Financial Support](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/admissions/tuition-and-scholarships/index.html): Tuition fees, scholarships, bursaries, and financial support information.
- [Funding Assistance](https://coned.ualberta.ca/resources/funding-assistance/index.jsp): Funding assistance, scholarships, and bursaries for continuing education students.

## Graduate & Postdoctoral Studies

- [Faculty of Graduate & Postdoctoral Studies](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/graduate-studies/index.html): Graduate and postdoctoral studies hub with admissions, funding, and support.
- [Graduate Programs](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/graduate-programs/index.html): Directory of graduate programs with admissions and funding information.

## Continuing Education & Professional Development

- [Continuing Education](https://coned.ualberta.ca): Continuing education homepage with professional development and online courses.
- [Programs + Courses](https://coned.ualberta.ca/program-courses/index.jsp): Continuing education program and course catalog with certificates and diplomas.
- [Organizational + Group Training](https://coned.ualberta.ca/organizational-services.jsp): Corporate training and organizational services for group employee development.

## Online Learning & Certificates

- [Online Learning](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/admissions-programs/online-learning.html): Online graduate certificates and distance education programs with digital pedagogy.
- [Online On-Demand Courses](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/admissions-programs/online-courses/index.html): MOOCs on Coursera covering paleontology, dinosaurs, Arctic, and software topics.
- [Embedded Undergraduate Certificates](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/admissions-programs/embedded-undergraduate-certificates/index.html): Embedded certificates in archaeology, data science, AI, and applied research.

## Faculties & Colleges

- [Colleges + Faculties](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/faculties/index.html): Directory of 18 faculties and colleges with research centres and institutes.
- [College of Health Sciences](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/health-sciences/index.html): College of Health Sciences with medicine, nursing, and kinesiology programs.

## Optional

- [Experiential Learning](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/experiential-learning/index.html): Experiential Learning Hub with work-integrated and land-based learning opportunities.
- [On Campus Inclusive Education](https://www.ualberta.ca/en/admissions-programs/inclusive-education/index.html): On Campus inclusive education program for students with developmental disabilities.
